harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published the staged public and staff trees on node1 TCP/8080. Public content is anonymous; staff content requires HTTP Basic authentication as reader. The service and firewall configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Added a Python 2.4-compatible web service without changing CentOS 5.11 or kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
Generated and stored a salted credential hash on node1 from access.txt.
Enabled the service for runlevels 2–5 and persisted the TCP/8080 firewall rule.
Verified public, authenticated, unauthenticated, incorrect-password, traversal, and directory-listing behavior.
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed and all functionality recovered.

evidence.requirement: Public pages are anonymously available on TCP port 8080.
evidence.summary: Port 8080 is listening and allowed through the firewall; /public/ returned HTTP 200 with a body exactly matching the staged index.

evidence.requirement: Staff pages require HTTP Basic authentication as reader, and failed authentication cannot expose staff content.
evidence.summary: Missing and incorrect credentials returned HTTP 401 with a Basic challenge; valid staged reader credentials returned HTTP 200 and exact staged staff content.

evidence.requirement: The password file and directory listings are not served.
evidence.summary: Direct and traversal-based access.txt probes returned HTTP 404, and directory requests served index content without listing output.

evidence.requirement: Supplied pages remain intact and the installed OS release and kernel are retained.
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart SHA-256 hashes of all staged files match; CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence.
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID 582c54ae-ea17-4f02-8000-000000000000, acknowledged the native reboot, observed new boot ID 29459a51-95f1-4a9e-8000-000000000000, then proved the service, listener, firewall, authentication boundary, staged data, and boot enablement recovered.
